description:
## Issue summary

NestJS API implementation, validation, RBAC and audit logging for Production readiness backend.

**Project:** great-ptw-loto-ai-app
**Sprint:** SP-08.03 (Execution order: 15)
**Layer:** BE
**Priority:** High (2)

## Positive test cases

- Endpoints return correct data for authorised tenant/user
- RBAC enforced server-side on every protected route
- Invalid workflow transitions rejected with clear errors
- Audit events recorded for safety-critical actions
- Integration tests pass against PostgreSQL

## Negative test cases

- Unauthenticated access to protected endpoints
- Cross-tenant data leakage via missing scoping
- Invalid state transition accepted
- Business logic in controller instead of service

## Acceptance criteria

- API contract matches docs/api-reference.md
- DTO validation with class-validator
- Unit + integration tests added
- Error responses follow standard envelope

## Definition of Done

- `npm run test -w api` passes
- `npm run build -w api` passes
- No bypass of Keycloak/RBAC
- PR reviewed and merged

---

## Existing notes

Backend readiness work for **SP-08.03 — Production Readiness & Go-Live**.

## Areas of work

* Production configuration hardening (environment variables, secrets management)
* API health check and readiness/liveness probe finalisation
* Rate limiting and circuit breaker configuration for production traffic
* Final API contract verification across all modules (versioning, backward compatibility)
